change_summary: Provider-free NBA original-final-boxscore prior-only player minutes/rates extraction from exact raw SHA-256 files and asserted capture receipts; research-only, no live forecast or card edits.
assumptions: NBA liveData original boxscore JSON schema includes gameId, gameStatus=3, gameTimeUTC, teams, personId, played and statistics fields; protocol changes fail closed.
Source receipt capture timestamps are caller assertions, not independently authenticated; a strict pre-target cutoff is necessary but insufficient proof of point-in-time eligibility.
Last-five observed minutes are NOT projected minutes; current roster and injury availability remain unverified and unusable for certified player-prop forecasts.
No sportsbook odds, player status inference, grading, stake, CLV, real source egress or model calibration is included; synthetic tests prove only structural and logic guards.
